narrative.details: Here's the Violet Powder, adventurer. Take it to Marin and tell him he owes me a favor!
narrative.objectives: Sprinkle wants to you take the Violet Powder to Marin Noggenfogger in Gadgetzan.
narrative.offerRewardText: Violet Powder, eh? Let's give it a try -- it sure couldn't make it any worse, that's for sure!
narrative.requestItemsText: Oh, adventurer, you're finally back.  What have you brought?
